paper_title: Constraints on axion-like particles with the Perseus Galaxy Cluster with MAGIC
notes: Paper presents 99% CL exclusion limits on ALP-photon coupling g_agamma from MAGIC observations of NGC 1275 in the Perseus Galaxy Cluster. Abstract states most stringent limits for ALP masses around 50 neV with g_agamma = 3×10^-12 GeV^-1. The parameter space scan covers 154 ALP models logarithmically spaced between 4×10^-9 eV and 1×10^-6 eV in mass, and 5×10^-13 to 5×10^-10 GeV^-1 in coupling. Figure 2 shows the full exclusion region at 99% CL. The strongest constraints occur around ma ~ 40-90 neV. Data points extracted from abstract statement and parameter space bounds; the horizontal line pairs represent the mass range of sensitivity for the coupling limits stated in the abstract and text. | selector: text (sole candidate)
